How we can help

Care begins with understanding what matters now.

Training and use vary by clinician. Profiles and direct confirmation remain the source of truth for a specific therapist.

In-person appointments are available in Woodinville. Secure telehealth may be available to eligible clients physically located in Washington, subject to clinical fit, clinician availability, and applicable requirements.

Related information

Explore therapy approaches

Cognitive Behavioral TherapyA structured approach that explores connections among thoughts, emotions, and behavior.→Dialectical Behavior Therapy SkillsSkills-oriented work that may support mindfulness, emotional regulation, distress tolerance, and relationships.→Emotionally Focused TherapyAn attachment-informed approach often used to understand emotional patterns and strengthen connection.→Gottman Method Informed TherapyRelationship work informed by research on friendship, conflict, repair, trust, and shared meaning.→Internal Family Systems Informed TherapyAn approach that can help clients relate to different internal experiences with greater curiosity and compassion.→Solution Focused Brief TherapyA goal-oriented approach that notices strengths, exceptions, resources, and practical next steps.→Narrative TherapyAn approach that separates people from problems and examines the stories shaping identity and possibility.→Motivational InterviewingA collaborative approach for exploring ambivalence, values, motivation, and personally meaningful change.→Attachment Based TherapyTherapy informed by how early and current relationships can influence safety, connection, and response patterns.→Family Systems TherapyAn approach that considers relationships, roles, patterns, and context rather than isolating one person as the problem.→Mindfulness Based TherapyPractices that may help clients notice internal experiences and respond with greater awareness and choice.→Trauma Informed TherapyCare organized around safety, choice, collaboration, trust, and sensitivity to the effects of difficult experiences.→
